description.value: Pizza Factory is a locally owned and operated pizza shop in Port Alberni that prides itself on house-made sauce and dough prepared fresh daily, sourcing ingredients from local suppliers. Beyond pizza, the menu spans pasta, burgers, fried chicken, poutine, and desserts, making it a substantial meal stop for cyclists riding through the Alberni Valley. Online ordering and delivery are available, and the shop offers gluten-free and dairy-free options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and fully corroborates the OSM record: address (4740 Roger Street, Port Alberni), primary phone (250-720-0088), and website URL all match. The pizza page lists gluten-free crust, cauliflower crust, and Daiya (dairy-free/vegan) cheese, confirming GF/vegan options. The site prominently features online ordering and a delivery service, confirming takeout; no bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (250-720-0099) not present in OSM; OSM only records the primary number (+1 250 720-0088).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Port Alberni with a confirmed website and menu. A solid meal stop for touring cyclists in the Alberni Valley.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'now accepting online orders' with an Order Online portal. Delivery also available with a minimum order

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Pizza page lists gluten-free crust, cauliflower crust, and Daiya (dairy-free/vegan) cheese as add-on options

wow_evidence: locally owned and operated pizza shop in Port Alberni
